description: Publish the draft as an immutable live version. Double-CAS (expectedDraftVersion + expectedPublishedVersionNumber) with confirmPublish acknowledgement; the response reports the APPLIED impact and exact stale-answer sweep counts, and a crash-retry with the same key replays them exactly. Requires job_checklists:write.

confirmPublish.description: Acknowledges this changes the live worker surface.

idempotencyKey.description: Durable-receipt idempotency key. Same key + same payload replays the stored receipt; same key + changed payload is a 409.

name: opentrain_job_checklists_publish
